chunks: 1818 - And on the first day of al-Muharram, Zakariyya عليه السلام supplicated to his Lord, Mighty and Majestic.
So whoever fasts on that day, Allah will answer him just as He answered Zakariyya عليه السلام.

key_terms.أَوَّلِ: the first, indicating the beginning of the month
key_terms.الْمُحَرَّمِ: Muharram, the sacred month being referred to

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for fasting on the first day of Muharram?
ai.summary: This hadith states the merit of fasting on the first day of Muharram. It connects that day with the supplication of Zakariyya عليه السلام and promises that Allah will answer the supplication of the one who fasts it, as He answered Zakariyya عليه السلام.
